Name: Portraits for Alex Mustacular
Author: r0tc0r3
Description:
[b][size=5]Install:[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Download the newest version of this mod from NexusMods﻿﻿
[*]Extract the ZIP-File and put the folder into the mods folder of SMAPI (mostly located under "C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods")
[/list]
[size=5][b]Features:
[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]New portraits for all seasons and events 
[*]Full compatibility with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url]
[/list]
